notes: A standing partnership in which NRW is a principal landowner member, and a direct line of sight to SI9 (impact of partnership approaches). It was convened under the previous administration, so whether the incoming government keeps it is worth watching.
summary: The Welsh Government announced on 13 March 2026 that Nature Estate Cymru, convened by the Deputy First Minister, held its first meeting on 12 March at the National Botanic Garden of Wales. It brought together major landowners including Natural Resources Wales, the three national park authorities, the National Trust, RSPB and Dwr Cymru, with an initial focus on tree planting targets and 30by30, and further work on water quality, invasive species, wildfire risk and public access. The same release named the first four sites recommended for full Naturfa status after a pilot that assessed twelve.
title: Nature Estate Cymru launched: major Welsh landowners, including NRW, convened to drive tree planting and 30by30; first four Naturfa sites named
